items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: So I went over and she said, 'Mr. Morton. This is the famous Jelly Roll Morton.' ... Anyway, I met him, and he talked to me about how long I'd been playing and all that.

ctx.x: I stayed down there for I guess about three months or so. A short while after that... I don't remember what terminated the job. But a short while after that, I was up on U Street in this particular place where I had worked, the Jungle Inn, where this lady Miss Lyles ran it... I was up there, and everybody was talking about the new manager they have at this club, and they're hinting around that he's Miss Lyles' boyfriend. Some people were saying that he was famous, and other people were making all sorts of…

So naturally, I went up there, and it was in the day, before the club had started... I went up there actually just to say hello to Miss Lyles and find out what was happening at the same time. And she says, "Oh, John, come on over. I want you to meet Mr. Morton." So I went over and she said, "Mr. Morton. This is the famous Jelly Roll Morton." So I didn't know who Jelly Roll Morton was. The only thing I heard mentioned about Jelly Roll was something Bessie Smith used to sing in a song, and she'd say something about…
